crossRefs.note: Now therefore send, and gather to me all Israel to Mount Carmel, and four hundred fifty of the prophets of Baal, and…
So Ahab sent to all the children of Israel, and gathered the prophets together to Mount Carmel.
They proclaimed a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people.
Sanctify a fast. Call a solemn assembly. Gather the elders, and all the inhabitants of the land, to the house of…

people.name: Jehu
people.line: Son of Jehoshaphat, king of Israel, destroyed Ahab's dynasty.

translations.web: Jehu said, “Sanctify a solemn assembly for Baal!” So they proclaimed it.
translations.bsb: And Jehu commanded, “Proclaim a solemn assembly for Baal.” So they announced it.
translations.kjv: And Jehu said, Proclaim a solemn assembly for Baal. And they proclaimed it.
translations.asv: And Jehu said, Sanctify a solemn assembly for Baal. And they proclaimed it.
